_readme: TIER ASSIGNMENTS for Sid's PC pool. The pool is a closed, enumerable set, so tiers are
assigned per fusion by JUDGMENT — not derived from any ability/item/species rule.
MODEL (standard Smogon nesting): every fusion has one home tier. A tier's legal pool is
its own members plus everything below it.
ubers = everything            (all fusions, incl. legendaries)
ou    = ou members + uu       (ubers members excluded)
uu    = uu members only       (ubers AND ou members excluded)
So listing a fusion under 'ubers' bans it from OU and UU; listing it under 'ou' bans it
from UU only. Anything not listed defaults to 'uu' and is therefore legal in every tier.
IDENTITY: the engine's own canonical fusion id — species symbol B<body_dex>H<head_dex>
(Marowak/Mimikyu == B373H105, dexNum = body*NB_POKEMON + head), stored on every Pokemon and
produced by getFusedPokemonIdFromDexNum. Immutable and exactly unique.
Write entries as 'HEAD/BODY' (resolved at load) or 'B373H105'. Order matters.
Nicknames are NOT accepted: they are auto-generated, change when a fusion is rebuilt, are
user-editable, and are NOT unique — four distinct fusions in this pool are all named
'Overload'. Entries are validated at load so typos fail loudly.
WHY ASSIGNMENT, NOT RULES: an earlier version derived OU from a mechanic ban (Huge Power /
Thick Club / Light Ball / Disguise / Multiscale). That mis-tiered mons badly — Volcachu
(Volcarona/Pikachu) was exiled to Ubers for holding a Light Ball while finishing DEAD LAST
(#100/100) on a measured ladder. Holding a strong toy is not the same as being strong.
Assignments below are evidence-backed where we have ladder data, and provisional judgment
otherwise; move a mon the moment data says so.
Standard clauses (Spore, Moody, Shadow Tag, Arena Trap, Baton Pass, Swagger, OHKO moves)
apply to EVERY tier and are handled separately in nladder.rb.

ubers.desc: Proven dominant. Measured as top-usage / top-team anchors on the unbanned ladders — an attack multiplier or a free-setup ability ON a chassis that actually converted it.

ou.desc: Banned from UU only. Two sources: (a) >=15% usage in the ladder_tou OU benchmark, (b) promoted for BREAKING UU on ladder_uu — a doubling mechanic on a top-10 UU team. Promotion is one tier at a time (Smogon-style): breaking UU makes a mon OU, not Ubers; Ubers requires breaking OU.

uu.desc: Everything else (default). Legal in every tier. Deliberately still includes mons that HOLD a doubling mechanic but never converted it — Volcarona/Pikachu (Light Ball, finished #100/100), Marowak/Arceus (Thick Club, #47), Golisopod/Mimikyu (Disguise, but a defensive Rocky Helmet pivot, not a setup abuser). Owning a strong toy is not a tiering offence; demonstrated dominance is.
